propositions: When a plan is re-reviewed after a BLOCK verdict, a deterministic pre-check must compare cited evidence anchors from the blocking findings against the current plan text to detect unchanged material.

If all matched evidence anchors remain verbatim and the plan's description component fingerprint is unchanged since the blocking review, a WARN-ONLY message must be emitted before re-review execution naming the persisting findings and their criteria.

Findings whose evidence anchors cannot be matched verbatim or lack traceable quotes must not independently trigger the warning; the warning fires only when at least one anchor is still present and all matchable anchors are untouched.

The precheck must record the warning flag (true or false) as precheck.cited_anchor_warning in the sidecar metrics on every plan review for offline measurement, with no hard-block verdict, no new flag, and no exit-code change.
